text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Kh...!! Ugh, this is so infuriating!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah... My deepest apologies. Please excuse 
me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I've been feeling irritated by every 
little thing lately...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, but would it be alright if I 
went to use the punching machine right 
now?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I shall unleash the raging fire in my 
heart with everything I have...!

Yaeno Muteki seems exhausted and stressed 
from running consecutive races. We might 
need to reconsider her future schedule.
